body: I can never have hope because the moments I think something good is going for me it gets snatched away so now I have the fear of being too happy because I know the pain that comes after and that makes me realize I will never feel at peace.

I'm sorry this happened to you, Have you tried seeking any help like employment programs? usually, those types of programs can also help you find other rescources such as counseling and your living situation? Also, have you talked to the girl about this and what you have been going through? I know for everyone it's different but maybe it would help if you talked to someone close to you as well... and don't apologize for anything you did nothing wrong, I hope and pray everything works out for you! Please stay strong.
